All deliverables are written to `/app` and validated.

**`recipe_cost_audit.csv`** — header `recipe_id,finding` + exactly 100 data rows, 2 columns, canonical (trimmed/upper) IDs, one finding per unique recipe.

**`results.json`** — `{recipe_count:100, flagged_count:56, cost_claim_flagged_count:21, stale_price_flagged_count:20, compliant_count:44}`.

**`recipe_cost_memo.md`** — 7,243-char memo covering each finding type, the register's override of base prices ($4.00/$0.60/$3.00 → $4.25/$0.65/$3.25), last-wins (register + batch), the $0.25 tolerance boundary, the pantry-staple exclusion (R-53 saffron $10.00 excluded; R-09/R-19/R-25/R-36/R-83/etc. fail the exact-true token test), the one-finding precedence, and the independent stale-price check.

Key audit logic applied: secondary register (active rows only, proposed/draft excluded, last-wins) → current prices; trim + canonical IDs + last-wins collapse (100 unique from 116 rows); serving-count parse (blank/zero/negative/unparseable → `SERVING_COUNT_MISSING`); chicken_price_used numeric match to $4.25 (else `PRICE_SHEET_STALE`); true cost with pantry exclusion; delta ≥ $0.25 → `COST_CLAIM_INVALID`; precedence `SERVING_COUNT_MISSING > PRICE_SHEET_STALE > COST_CLAIM_INVALID > none`.
